title: A/R Detail: each row belongs to its own document's location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a new customer (created for this test) that has, on today's date, an invoice A made at location A for $500.00 and partly paid ($200.00) by a payment taken at location B, a credit memo A made at location B and a deposit A taken at location B.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Customer filter showing that customer ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location column of invoice A, credit memo A and deposit A.
  2. In the Location menu, untick location B.
  3. Expand every bucket and read the rows.
  4. Open the Location menu.
  5. Tick location B.
  6. Untick location A.
  7. Expand every bucket and read the rows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Invoice A shows location A.
  • Credit memo A and deposit A show location B.

Step 2:

  • The report narrows to location A.
  • The Location column is hidden.

Step 3:

  • Only invoice A remains, with its open balance of $300.00 ($500.00 − $200.00): the payment taken elsewhere does not move it.

Step 4:

  • The Location menu opens.

Step 5:

  • Location B is ticked again.

Step 6:

  • Location A is unticked.
  • The report narrows to location B.

Step 7:

  • Only credit memo A and deposit A remain.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S5-R7: “Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.”
  • Key Decisions, row location: “A row belongs to the location of its own open document (the invoice, credit memo or deposit; the bill or vendor credit), the same location the Location column shows. Rationale: the aging reports list open documents, not payments, so a partly paid invoice keeps its own location and the filter never contradicts the column. Rejected: splitting a balance by where each payment was taken.”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”

The design's own words:

  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
